title: A frontmatter of 65,536 characters loads; one of 65,537 fails its check
notes: The frontmatter counted is the text between its two '---' lines, without the line breaks that bound it. Each frontmatter pads a YAML comment, which its entry does not hold: 'at' takes exactly 65,536 characters, written with a two-byte character so that it holds more than 65,536 bytes; 'past' takes 65,537 characters. RK-24.1-007 is cited in part: its served half (the content fails its check) is observed; its local half (a host's own SKILL.md past the bound cannot be parsed) needs a local skill written from raw frontmatter, which the local skill fixture does not write.

results.message: Skill 'docs:past' changed on its server or could not be verified
